method.calibration: axis frame found from spine rules; tick-label bounding-box centres; scale fitted over all labels; offset anchored on the axis minimum at the frame edge; label-vs-frame discrepancy reported as the calibration uncertainty
method.series: hue classification by channel difference (experimental marks and each protein's colour; model prediction purple); legend boxes excluded; mark centroids and per-column trace medians read in data units
method.limits: points where a raster column holds several trace branches are marked ambiguous, not averaged; a curve that coincides with an axis spine is not separately resolved and the span limit is recorded
